name: Ryozeki Shuzo
about: Ryozeki Shuzo is a sake brewery in Yuzawa, Akita, founded in 1874. Its brewery is a nationally registered tangible cultural property, and its stated policy is a sake born of harmony among people that in turn brews harmony among people.

Its range includes Ryozeki, Hanamura and Suigyoku. Suigyoku, named for the emerald, was developed with technical support from Takagi Shuzo, the Juyondai brewery in Yamagata, as a second line after Hanamura, and its labels deliberately print no specifications.
